'''T4-U5''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It belonged to [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Devon Race]].<ref name="TOR" />
